item.text:
root = Card("expense_review", "High-value expense review", content)
content = Stack("review_content", [context, status_filter, expenses, review_note, approve_expense, result])

expenses = Table("expense_table", ["expense_id", "merchant", "amount", "status"], [{"expense_id":"exp-001","merchant":"Strategy Partners","amount":"EUR 4,800.00","status":"pending"},{"expense_id":"exp-002","merchant":"Research Associates","amount":"EUR 2,200.00","status":"pending"}])
review_note = Input("review_note_input", "Reviewer note", "review_note", "")
approve_expense = Button("approve_expense_button", "Approve exp-001", {"name":"ApproveExpense","expense_id":"exp-001"})
result = Alert("approval_result", "info", "Pending review: exp-001 is ready for approval. exp-002 remains pending.")
